fields.reasoning: internal/guide/text/conduct.md:38 has the conductor spawn only --role check-plan, check-code and check-qa. check-compliance is spawned only by classic kind=checks steps (internal/workflow/builtin/review.toml:45, .rhiza/workflows/docs-review.toml:31), which shallow-round-needs-leaf-coverage leaves unchanged with evidence optional. Telling the compliance check a round is refused in a conductor run describes a refusal it never meets, so the guide would be wrong; keeping it unchanged also matches the leaf's existing treatment of the other classic checks (check-quality, check-model in must_not). The alternative (keep it and explain a conductor might run it) has no support in the code or conduct guide, and evidence remains accepted-but-optional in classic rounds, so nothing is lost by leaving its guide as is.
fields.statement: Drop check-compliance from leaf check-guides-evidence-lines: the evidence-list and uncovered-leaf-refusal guidance goes only into the guides of the checks a conductor spawns (check-plan, check-code, check-qa) and their tests. internal/guide/text/check-compliance.md and internal/guide/check_compliance_test.go are left unchanged and move to the leaf's must_not, beside check-quality and check-model. The phrase 'check-compliance guidance used by conductors' in Decision shallow-round-needs-leaf-coverage is read as the three conductor check guides only; the refusal itself stays name-independent in code as that Decision says.
